representation: binary64 values are ulong IEEE-754 bit patterns; binary32 inputs/outputs are uint encodings
rounding_target: source CUDA round-to-nearest, ties-to-even operation boundaries

translation.log2: Pinned 16-entry POWF_INVC and POWF_LOGC tables, five POWF_A coefficients, and the exact scalar operation order are transcribed into integer-bit binary64 operations.
translation.pow: Pinned unsigned-bit special-case branches, checkint classification, sign-bias selection, subnormal normalization, overflow/underflow thresholds, binary64 product, and final RN binary32 conversion are transcribed.
translation.exp2: Called through the exp-owned soft_gfk_exp2_core_bits interface; this packet contains no exp2/log API or implementation.

base_dependency.state: The shared primitives are used by production consumers; their bounded verification does not establish exhaustive behavior. Each consumer requires its own source comparison.

constraints: No native float or double arithmetic, approximation, generic libm replacement, or duplicated log/exp API is used.
The pow-owned log2 polynomial is kept inline with its source constants and ordered operations.
The shared binary32, binary64 and exp interfaces are present; a production consumer requires its own numerical comparison. Bounded results do not establish exhaustive parity.
